title: Towards the selectivity and energetics of anti-Bredt olefins – a density functional theory approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,285-291
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09135G, Paper

Pritam Chakraborty, Jannat Alam, Bibitha Poulose, Shyama Ramakrishnan, Padmesh Anjukandi
Molecular geometry influences ABO formation. According to Bredt's rule, bridgehead double bonds are disfavored due to poor p-orbital overlap. In some precursors, strain relief enables efficient overlap, allowing anti-Bredt olefin formation.
